text.en:
Salary Increases. The following officials and employees of the Office of the Tanodbayan shall receive
their annual salaries in accordance with the following rates:
SALARY RATE
Tanodbayan
Deputy Tanodbayan
67,896
Executive Director
58,476
Directors of Prosecution and Investigation; Legal; Administrative; and Finance, Management and Planning
52,944
Special Prosecutors
50,376
Chief Legal Officers
47,928
Investigators
47,928
Legal Officers II
41,292
Trial Attorneys

37,380
Legal Officers I
32,196
Legal Researcher
26,388

The procedures, rules and regulations needed to carry out this Executive Order shall be formulated and
issued by the Minister of the Budget.

The amounts necessary to cover the salary increases herein provided shall be drawn from salary lapses
and other personal services savings of the Office of the Tanodbayan.

The salary increases herein provided shall be effective March 1, 1981.
Done in the City of Manila, this 17th day of November, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
